text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Dadadada!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna... get stroooong!
Little by little~, bit by biiiiit!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*Haa, fuu*...
How was that, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Before her growth spurt. Even so, results are gradually
showing. If she keeps this up...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Once my growth phase finally begins...
Could it be that in the spring—around springtime,
Opera O-san might finally acknowledge me?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, ehehehe... Please wait for me, Opera O-san.
I'll definitely be by your side...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The race for next year's Classics is still wide open. If only his body develops, he might even catch up to T.M. Opera O...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Doto-saaan!
Trainer-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru-san?
Is something the matter~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Just an urgent update!
I was reading Doto-san's horoscope,
and it showed an utterly ominous omen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: An astonishing new star is about to be born in the western sky. A mysterious binary star that appears as two, yet is truly one!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That rising star will cast a shadow over the golden star,
and will surely become a formidable threat to Doto and many other Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A new star... and a binary star?
Does that mean—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The same day. Hanshin Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UAAAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The rising star, Admire Vega, takes a complete victory!
Pulling away effortlessly to claim a brilliant graded race win!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Stepping forward as one of the Classic season's leading stars!
With a running style almost heartbreakingly stoic,
where will she head next—?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The vow... has not yet been fulfilled.
Our goal is—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —Eastward. Toward the skies of Fuchu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawawawa, class is about to starttt.
I gotta hurry, gotta hurry~~~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thump!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaah!? I'm so sorrryyyy! Did I go and blast someone away with a huge crash againnn?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Huh, she didn't get knocked back...?
Usually, when I bump into someone, they go crashing into the wall.)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: (Wait, this person is...!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You should really look ahead.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
H-Hahaha, yeeees! I'm so sorry~!
Admire Vega-san... Ayabe-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... I-I-I watched Ayabe-san's race
on UmaTube the other day.
It was so cool, and terrifyingly fast...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —This isn't a game.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm not running just for fun.
If I looked scary, that's why.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Because... I can't afford to lose.
See you later, then.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Doto! Are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah, Opera O-san, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
That person just now was Admire Vega-san...
Ayabe-san.
She's from my class, and she's a very strong Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, she is indeed on my cast list.
After that recent race, she went off loud and clear
on my Conqueror Radar, after all."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"The day will surely come when we meet upon the grand stage.
Oh, Ayabe-san!
Why art thou not Adobe?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer,
there's something I'd like to talk to you about...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san, when I bumped into you earlier, you didn't budge at all. Even though you're so slender.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Instead, I was the one who got repelled.
If that's the body of someone who's truly strong, then I've still got a long way to go..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega. Calm, solitary—
A rising star blessed with supple legs...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A powerful rival appeared
to stand between Meisho Doto and T.M. Opera O.
